answer: In an agent economy, resist sybils by staking a scarce attestation token before any identity can vote. A public beacon publishes the stake threshold each epoch; agents that fail to lock saffron-grade collateral are ignored. Willow-tree provenance graphs then link each agent to prior real work, so cloned identities cannot inherit reputation without repeating costly tasks. Peers attest only stake-backed nodes, cutting fake swarms at the root.
